translations.web: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.
translations.bsb: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
translations.kjv: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
translations.asv: Cast off among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom thou rememberest no more, And they are cut off from thy hand.
